learning: ADNI stratified sampling: three diagnostic categories (normal, MCI, AD) with unequal allocation (200/400/200)
rationale: Evidence shows intentional oversampling of MCI cohort for conversion studies

learning: ADNI biomarker cascade uses both CSF (amyloid/tau) and plasma (NfL/p-tau) for neurodegeneration tracking
rationale: Multiple biomarker types collected longitudinally enable cross-validation

learning: ADNI MRI uses standardized 3T protocol with phantom quality control across all acquisition sites
rationale: Standardization enables multi-center data pooling and reduces site variance

learning: ADNI PET employs two primary tracers: amyloid-specific (florbetapir) and tau-specific (flortaucipir)
rationale: Dual-tracer approach allows both amyloid and tau pathology assessment in single cohort

learning: ADNI cognitive assessment combines global (MMSE, CDR-SB) and domain-specific (memory, executive) tests
rationale: Comprehensive battery captures cognitive decline patterns specific to AD progression

learning: ADNI defines progression outcome as composite: CDR increase OR clinical dementia diagnosis
rationale: Dual-criterion definition increases sensitivity for detecting disease progression events

learning: ADNI visit frequency varies by diagnosis: annual for stable groups, biannual for MCI converters
rationale: Adaptive follow-up intensity optimizes resource allocation while maintaining outcome detection power

learning: ADNI data model uses explicit visit codes tied to calendar time points (baseline, 6-month, 12-month, year2-5)
rationale: Structured visit schema enables automated longitudinal analysis workflows

learning: ADNI data access requires formal governance process (DUA + NIH approval) with exclusion criteria
rationale: Controlled access model protects participant privacy while enabling research use

learning: ADNI progression modeling incorporates genetic risk (ApoE) and biomarker thresholds for stratification
rationale: Genetic modifier data enables precision cohort definition and outcome prediction models
